name: Slice 2: Outliner columns, truncation, expand and collapse, rename with F2

comments.text: Kind column widened so moving_platform fits. Expand and collapse already exist. F2 rename not done: needs an inline text input in the row and a rename host call; still open.

F2 rename is blocked by gaps in Penumbra: no focus API from Nyx (an input cannot be focused by a key), no double-click event, and no submit or Enter event on input. Inline rename needs those three first; they belong as cards on the Penumbra and Nyx boards. Until then rename in the inspector Name field.
